0022600001.text: Both the Boston Celtics and Detroit Pistons open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with Boston on the road. Five Celtics are listed as day-to-day with rest and are game-time decisions: Derrick White, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Payton Pritchard, and Sam Hauser. Boston lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 104-103 defeat in Detroit on January 19, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Celtics a 50% chance of winning.
